stories-23-12-14-four-embryological-stag.title: Four Sequential Embryological Stages Clothed With Bones and Flesh
stories-23-12-14-four-embryological-stag.note: Surah 23:12–14 describes human development from clay extract to a drop of fluid (`nutfah`), a clot (`alaqah`), a lump (`mudghah`), and bones clothed with flesh, matching the blood-and-flesh gestational stages in Talmud Bavli Niddah 25a.

discussion.view: Traditional and modern commentators present the four stages in Surah 23:12–14—drop, clot, lump, and bones clothed with flesh—as revealed scientific knowledge of human gestation.
discussion.reply: Each stage mirrors Late Antique medical and rabbinic models: Talmud Bavli Niddah 25a distinguishes early gestational sacs 'full of blood' from the subsequent stage 'full of flesh' (cf. Niddah 30b–31a), while Galen's De Semine (On Semen I.8–10, CMG V 3,1) divides embryogenesis into four sequential stages from seminal fluid to a blood-filled coagulum, an unarticulated fleshy mass, and hardened bones subsequently clothed with muscle.

stories-23-12-14-four-embryological-stag.quranEn: [12] Certainly We created the human from an extract of clay. [13] Then We made him a drop in a secure dwelling place, [14] then We made a clot (from) the drop, then We made a lump (from) the clot, then We made bones (from) the lump, then We clothed the bones (with) flesh, (and) then We (re)produced him as another creature. So blessed (be) God, the best of creators!
quranHighlights: Then We made him a drop in a secure dwelling place
then We made a clot (from) the drop, then We made a lump (from) the clot, then We made bones (from) the lump, then We clothed the bones (with) flesh

sources.title: Babylonian Talmud, Tractate Niddah
sources.ref: Niddah 25a (Gestational Sac Full of Blood and Full of Flesh)
sources.en: Rabbi Yishmael, son of Rabbi Yosei, said to him: This is what my father, i.e., Rabbi Yosei ben Ḥalafta, one of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi’s teachers, said: If a woman discharged a gestational sac full of blood, she is impure with the impurity of a menstruating woman. If it is full of flesh, she is impure with the impurity of a woman after childbirth.
highlights: If a woman discharged a gestational sac full of blood, she is impure with the impurity of a menstruating woman. If it is full of flesh, she is impure with the impurity of a woman after childbirth.
sources.orig: אָמַר לְפָנָיו רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי: כָּךְ אָמַר אַבָּא — מָלֵא דָּם טְמֵאָה נִדָּה, מָלֵא בָּשָׂר טְמֵאָה לֵידָה.

stories-23-50-jesus-and-mary-sheltered-o.title: Mary and Her Son Sheltered on High Ground with a Flowing Spring
stories-23-50-jesus-and-mary-sheltered-o.note: Surah 23:50 states that God gave the son of Mary and his mother refuge on high ground with a restful hollow and a flowing spring (rabwatin dhati qararin wa-ma'in), combining the mountain refuge of Protevangelium 22 with the spring of Pseudo-Matthew 20.

discussion.view: Al-Tabari and Ibn Kathir report varying geographical identifications among early commentators for the 'high ground with a restful hollow and flowing spring' in 23:50, including Damascus, Ramla, Jerusalem, and Egypt during the flight from Herod.
discussion.reply: Unlike 19:23–26, where Mary gives birth alone beside a palm tree and a stream (sariyyan), 23:50 describes God sheltering both the son of Mary and his mother on high ground (rabwah) with a flowing spring. This combines the cleft mountain refuge of the Protevangelium of James 22 with the miraculous spring of water opened beneath the palm tree during the flight to Egypt in Pseudo-Matthew 20.

sources.title: Protoevangelium of James (Infancy Gospel of James)
sources.workSub: Protoevangelium of James (Infancy Gospel of James)
sources.en: And Elizabeth , having heard that they were searching for John, took him and went up into the hill-country, and kept looking where to conceal him. And there was no place of concealment. And Elizabeth , groaning with a loud voice, says: O mountain of God , receive mother and child. And immediately the mountain was cleft, and received her. And a light shone about them, for an angel of the Lord was with them, watching over them.
highlights: went up into the hill-country, and kept looking where to conceal him
O mountain of God , receive mother and child. And immediately the mountain was cleft, and received her.

sources.title: Gospel of Pseudo-Matthew
sources.en: Then Jesus said to it: Raise yourself, O palm tree, and be strong, and be the companion of my trees, which are in the paradise of my Father; and open from your roots a vein of water which has been hid in the earth, and let the waters flow, so that we may be satisfied from you. And it rose up immediately, and at its root there began to come forth a spring of water exceedingly clear and cool and sparkling. And when they saw the spring of water, they rejoiced with great joy , and were satisfied, themselves and all their cattle and their beasts. Wherefore they gave thanks to God .
